Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast
Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast (CCBN) is using Darktrace / EMAIL to scale email protection across millions of emails annually, significantly reducing the manual burden on the security team without slowing business operations.
Customer Stories
HARMAN International
HARMAN International safeguards its vast network of data, communications, and intellectual property with Darktrace coverage for email, network, and OT systems.
Customer Stories
Centre Parcs
Centre Parcs turned to Darktrace to protect their network, email, and cloud environments with a single AI security platform.
Cyber AI
Built on our unique AI approach
Rather than teaching an AI system what an ‘attack’ looks like, training it on large data lakes of thousands of organizations’ data, Darktrace AI learns from your unique business data to understand what is normal to identify high risk, anomalous activity for each asset across domains. This enables it to detect subtle deviations that signal a threat, including novel and AI-driven cyber-attacks.
